ucs.title: [LLM] DragonForce ransomware pre-encryption chain: vssadmin shadow deletion + bcdedit recovery disable + service stop on the same host
ucs.description: Detects DragonForce's characteristic pre-encryption preparation sequence — wiping VSS shadow copies, disabling Windows Recovery Environment, and killing AV/backup services within a tight window on a single host. DragonForce (Malaysian e-crime collective, LockBit Black / Conti leaked-builder based affiliate program, used by Scattered Spider affiliates against Marks & Spencer / Co-op / Harrods in 2025) hard-codes this sequence into its encryptor before file rename to .dragonforce_encrypted.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as processes values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe","net.exe","sc.exe","taskkill.exe","powershell.exe") AND (Processes.process="*shadowcopy delete*" OR Processes.process="*shadows delete*" OR Processes.process="*delete shadows*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled no*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures*" OR Processes.process="*delete catalog -quiet*" OR Processes.process="*Veeam*" OR Processes.process="*MSSQL*" OR Processes.process="*Backup*" OR Processes.process="*MemTas*" OR Processes.process="*Sophos*" OR Processes.process="*WinDefend*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process _time span=1m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eventstats dc(process_name) as distinct_techniques by dest user | where distinct_techniques>=3 | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let WindowMin = 10m;
let PreEncryptionCmds = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | where (FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows"))
         or (FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("shadowcopy","delete"))
         or (FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and (ProcessCommandLine has "recoveryenabled no" or ProcessCommandLine has "bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"))
         or (FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete","catalog"))
         or (FileName in~ ("net.exe","sc.exe","taskkill.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Veeam","MSSQL","SQLWriter","Backup","MemTas","Sophos","WinDefend","MsMpEng","SecurityHealthService"))
    | extend Technique = case(
        FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" or FileName =~ "wmic.exe", "ShadowDelete",
        FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe", "RecoveryDisable",
        FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe", "BackupCatalogDelete",
        "ServiceStop")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, Technique;
PreEncryptionCmds
| summarize Techniques = make_set(Technique),
            TechniqueCount = dcount(Technique),
            EventCount = count(),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            SampleCmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 5),
            ParentTree = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 5)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, WindowMin)
| where TechniqueCount >= 2     // 2+ of {ShadowDelete, RecoveryDisable, BackupCatalogDelete, ServiceStop} within 10m = DragonForce pre-encrypt
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let WindowMin = 10m;
let PreEnc = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where AccountType != "Machine"
    | extend Img = tolower(NewProcessName), Cmd = tolower(CommandLine)
    | where (Img endswith "\\vssadmin.exe" and Cmd has_all ("delete","shadows"))
         or (Img endswith "\\wmic.exe" and Cmd has_all ("shadowcopy","delete"))
         or (Img endswith "\\bcdedit.exe" and (Cmd has "recoveryenabled no" or Cmd has "bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"))
         or (Img endswith "\\wbadmin.exe" and Cmd has_all ("delete","catalog"))
         or (Img endswith "\\net.exe" or Img endswith "\\sc.exe" or Img endswith "\\taskkill.exe") and Cmd has_any ("veeam","mssql","sqlwriter","backup","memtas","sophos","windefend","msmpeng","securityhealthservice")
    | extend Technique = case(
        Img endswith "\\vssadmin.exe" or Img endswith "\\wmic.exe", "ShadowDelete",
        Img endswith "\\bcdedit.exe", "RecoveryDisable",
        Img endswith "\\wbadmin.exe", "BackupCatalogDelete",
        "ServiceStop")
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, Technique;
PreEnc
| summarize Techniques = make_set(Technique),
            TechniqueCount = dcount(Technique),
            EventCount = count(),
            FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated),
            LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            SampleCmds = make_set(CommandLine, 5)
            by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMin)
| where TechniqueCount >= 2
| order by LastSeen desc

ucs.rationale: DragonForce's leaked-builder lineage (LockBit Black + Conti) hard-codes this exact sequence: vssadmin → bcdedit → service-stop list (Veeam/MSSQL/Sophos/MemTas) → encryptor. Requiring 2+ distinct technique categories within 10 minutes on the same host suppresses the common legitimate single-vssadmin call (backup script) and the standalone bcdedit (sysadmin troubleshoot) while catching the affiliate

ucs.title: [LLM] DragonForce affiliate initial access via SimpleHelp RMM exploitation (CVE-2024-57727) followed by reconnaissance
ucs.description: Hunts the DragonForce affiliate playbook of compromising MSP-deployed SimpleHelp RMM servers (CVE-2024-57727 path traversal → CVE-2024-57728 arbitrary file upload) and pivoting to downstream customer endpoints via the SimpleHelp Remote Access client, where the spawned remote-access session immediately runs network discovery / credential-staging commands. Sophos and CISA attributed at least one DragonForce ransomware deployment in 2025 to this MSP-pivot vector.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmds values(Processes.process_name) as child_bins from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("Remote Access.exe","SimpleService.exe","SimpleHelpCustomer.exe","JWrapper-Remote Access.exe") OR Processes.parent_process="*SimpleHelp*" OR Processes.parent_process="*Remote Access*") AND Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","nltest.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","whoami.exe","quser.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","ipconfig.exe","arp.exe","route.exe","reg.exe","rundll32.exe","procdump.exe","comsvcs.dll","wmic.exe","adfind.exe","advanced_ip_scanner.exe","netscan.exe","mimikatz.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name _time span=15m | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eventstats dc(process_name) as recon_cmd_variety by dest user | where recon_cmd_variety>=3 | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 24h;
let WindowMin = 15m;
let SimpleHelpParents = dynamic(["remote access.exe","simpleservice.exe","simplehelpcustomer.exe","jwrapper-remote access.exe","simplegatewayservice.exe"]);
let ReconBins   = dynamic(["nltest.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","whoami.exe","quser.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","ipconfig.exe","arp.exe","route.exe","hostname.exe","qwinsta.exe"]);
let CredOrTooling = dynamic(["procdump.exe","rundll32.exe","reg.exe","mimikatz.exe","adfind.exe","advanced_ip_scanner.exe","netscan.exe","softperfect network scanner.exe"]);
let Shells = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where tolower(InitiatingProcessFileName) in (SimpleHelpParents)
     or InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any ("\\SimpleHelp\\","\\JWrapper-Remote Access\\","\\Remote Access\\")
| extend ChildLower = tolower(FileName)
| extend Category = case(
    ChildLower in (ReconBins), "Recon",
    ChildLower in (CredOrTooling) or (ChildLower == "rundll32.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "comsvcs"), "CredOrTool",
    ChildLower in (Shells), "Shell",
    "Other")
| where Category != "Other"
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName, ParentPath = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ChildImage = FileName, ProcessCommandLine, Category
| summarize ReconCount = countif(Category == "Recon"),
            CredToolCount = countif(Category == "CredOrTool"),
            ShellCount = countif(Category == "Shell"),
            DistinctChildren = dcount(ChildImage),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            SampleCmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 10),
            ParentPaths = make_set(ParentPath, 3)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, WindowMin)
| where (ReconCount >= 3 and ShellCount >= 1) or CredToolCount >= 1
| order by LastSeen desc
